title: Finite-time circuit unrolling
statement: For a sequential Boolean circuit with $n$ inputs and any $T\in\mathbb{N}$, define a directed acyclic circuit with $n$ sources by listing, in order, the gates at positions $0$ through $(T+1)s-1$ from the circuit's unrolling, where $s$ is the sequential circuit's size. Its output vertex is the placement at time step $T$ of the original combinational circuit's output vertex.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a sequential circuit with natural-number input and register counts
the gate list has length $(T+1)$ times the sequential circuit size
